moments.text: Green title card: "Unclassified", footage from mission report 8339574, 15 JAN 23 1251Z.
Infrared sensor view of hazy sky, brighter band across the upper half, crosshair and tracking box at centre. A tiny dark speck hovers just right of the crosshair.
The picture flashes black, grey and white, then switches to a wider view with a dark circular vignette around the crosshair.
A small dark shape left of the crosshair moves right until it reaches the crosshair.
A small round dark spot sits just above and right of the crosshair, almost still.
Black and white flashes and blocky frames, then a closer zoom: the dark object, now larger, sits above the crosshair.
The object drifts right, then the view snaps back and it jumps left; this repeats. A short dark smear trails behind it near the end.
The view zooms in further: a dark blotch with a spiky halo, sweeping left to right again and again. Faint small square marks trail to its left.
The object leaves the right edge and the frame is empty for about 1.5 s; only a fixed white dot on the right remains.
The object re-enters at the right edge and crosses right to left, leaving at the left edge; it returns from the left about a second later.
After slipping off the right edge again, it comes back from the right and crosses right to left before resuming its left-to-right sweeps.
The object leaves the right edge; the frame is empty as the clip ends.
